slides.stem: A data set of seven numbers has a mean of $30$. When six of the numbers are removed, the mean of those six removed numbers is $32$. What is the value of the remaining number?

slides.intro: Means hide totals. Work with the totals.
slides.trapWhy: $30$ and $32$ are both bait. The leftover number balances the totals, not the means.

slides.title: Convert every mean to a total
slides.body:
Mean times count equals total. Turn each mean into its total, and missing-value questions become subtraction.

The moment two means appear in one problem, totals are the only safe currency.

slides.title: When you miss one like this, Seva tells you why.
slides.body: A content gap, a trap answer, and rushing all look identical on a score report. They need different fixes. Seva tells them apart and rebuilds your plan around the real one.
